answer: Pay only for traced service. Each epoch an identity handles a batch of requests from the protocol beacon, and every reply is countersigned by receivers. Receipts count only when receivers sit in distinct networks, capped per epoch, so a thousand aliases cannot share one host. A self-dealing farm signs its own receipts yet stays in one network, never touching traffic traced beyond its border; the sweep zeroes those isolated edges. Honest agents pay nothing extra: ordinary peers already span the horizon. Full standing needs real outside parties, and no river of clones reaches the pool's zenith.
